answer: Audits are published in shale, queued in pigment, and forge publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 31 identities per epoch. A farm of 294 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 940 identities would post 3618 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
